Evaluate the following statement using only the passage, choosing an assessment with a sound justification:

At least one additional member must arrive before the quorum condition is satisfied.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Not deducible: the passage does not settle it.

options.label: B
options.textMd: True, because the meeting currently has four members present.

options.label: C
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

explanationMd: The presence count must rise from five to at least six; one additional member reaches the threshold.

distractorRationale.b: This assessment uses a premise that is contradicted by or absent from the passage. A matching classification with an unsound justification is not correct. The presence count must rise from five to at least six; one additional member reaches the threshold.
distractorRationale.d: The passage does not support this classification as a contradiction. The presence count must rise from five to at least six; one additional member reaches the threshold.
